observations: A large solar panel with a silver frame leaning against a wall.
The panel features half-cut cell technology, visible by the horizontal split in the middle.
There is a prominent white line/mark on the lower half of the panel that appears to be a crack in the glass.
A watermark 'UZORBEST ELECTRICAL & SOLAR' is visible across the center.
No manufacturer label or specification sticker is visible on the front or sides.

Voltage ratings are only found on the specification label, which is not shown.
